subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this dependency batch proceed with the Socket obfuscated-code alerts for `@react-email/ui@6.6.6` and the Vite-transitive `@emnapi/runtime@1.11.1`, or should those bumps be split out or held?
rationale: The formatter failure is mechanical, but the new obfuscated-code alerts are a supply-chain risk decision that automation should not silently accept for maintainers.

options.title: Split alerting bumps
options.body: Drop or split the `@react-email/ui` and Vite-related updates until the Socket warnings are reviewed, then commit the required formatter output for the remaining batch.

options.title: Accept and document risk
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept or ignore the Socket warnings for this PR and require only the formatter output before merge.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Close or pause this broad dependency PR and let Dependabot reopen narrower updates that are easier to validate and triage.

recommendation.title: Split alerting bumps
recommendation.body: Drop or split the `@react-email/ui` and Vite-related updates until the Socket warnings are reviewed, then commit the required formatter output for the remaining batch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent package/dependabot/static-gate history and the latest package-script work route this decision most closely to Patrick-Erichsen.
